work.name: Ernst & Young (EY) India
highlights: Delivered OT security recommendations aligned with NIST CSF, IEC 62443, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 to strengthen industrial cybersecurity posture, improve compliance readiness, and support the organization in achieving regulatory alignment across operational technology environments.

Assessed OT network switches, firewalls, and overall network architecture to identify security gaps, evaluate existing controls, and recommend targeted remediation measures to enhance network resilience and reduce attack surface.

Redesigned OT network architecture by developing revised network diagrams aligned with the Purdue Enterprise Reference Architecture (Purdue Model) to improve network segmentation, enforce defense-in-depth principles, and ensure secure IT–OT interfaces.

Collaborated closely with IT, cybersecurity, network, and infrastructure teams to support cross-functional OT security initiatives and ensure secure integration between IT and OT environments across client engagements.

Delivered data privacy and protection advisory services for a telecommunications client, applying ISO 27701:2025 (PIMS), GDPR, and Bangladesh's PDPA/NDMA regulations; conducted PIMS gap assessments, Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA), and developed data flow diagrams and Records of Processing Activities (ROPA).

Contributed to business development by drafting client proposals and responding to RFPs for prospective OT security, cybersecurity governance, and data privacy engagements across multiple industry verticals.

work.name: PwC India (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
highlights: Conducted IT and OT cybersecurity audits and governance assessments using ISA/IEC 62443, ISO 27001:2022, and NIST CSF 2.0, delivering OT security maturity assessments, risk reports, and actionable recommendations that improved clients' security posture by up to 40%.

Developed OT security policies, procedures, and network diagrams (As-Is / To-Be) aligned with regulatory standards, reducing compliance gaps by 30%; created Power BI dashboards to visualize OT vulnerabilities and supported clients in ISO certification readiness.

Used OT security tools including Claroty, Nozomi Networks, Wireshark, and Tenable for vulnerability assessment (VA/PT) and risk remediation across industrial OT environments, cutting critical vulnerabilities by 25%.
Performed OT SOC monitoring using Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for IoT, and Lansweeper to detect threats, track OT assets, and maintain continuous security visibility across industrial environments.

Led ISA/IEC 62443 OT cybersecurity audit for a cement manufacturer — created compliance dashboards, risk registers, and network diagrams for a To-Be OT security architecture, resulting in a 30% reduction in identified risks.

Conducted on-site ISO 27001:2022 IT/OT assessment for a steel manufacturer — developed gap reports, risk registers, and dashboards, enabling successful certification and reducing OT-environment risks by 35%.
